challenge.better_approach: Considered: have reseal drop GIT_INDEX_FILE before calling the tester. It keeps that variable on purpose for its own index question (ticket ca9d380fe9d6), so the caller that runs git in another repo is the one to scrub, at the one helper all its gits go through.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That nothing in red_tickets needs the hook's git context. Every git it runs is -C <commons top>, so none does; the proof's full-env tooth measures it.
challenge.prior_art: reseal._commits_touching already scrubs GIT_* (its docstring cites the hook's GIT_INDEX_FILE). The 207c4074b3d5 proof never ran under a hook env. No ticket in the corpus names red_tickets and GIT_INDEX_FILE.
challenge.real_collision: none: ca9d380fe9d6 keeps GIT_INDEX_FILE inside reseal's own question, and this drops it only for gits aimed at the commons.

answers.falsifier: Under another repo's GIT_INDEX_FILE, _staged(commons) returns the commons' own staged list. A cast under a hook's env commits into the commons and leaves the hook repo untouched. The outline check sees no GIT_*.
answers.from_idea: none, because this was measured, not imagined: akienasus_cc_0 found that 94b599b2c33f, the blob behind 'unable to read' in the commons, is cairn's README.md at stage 0 of cairn's index (git -C cairn cat-file -t says blob), and that every land_ours held reseal hit COULD NOT RUN (q57 on 1919, q62 on 8d69); relay 2026-11-15
answers.how: red_tickets gets one helper that returns os.environ minus every GIT_* variable, as reseal._commits_touching already does. _git and the outline-check subprocess use it. A red-first proof runs _staged and a full cast under a foreign GIT_INDEX_FILE, GIT_DIR and GIT_WORK_TREE.
answers.traces_to: Law 7 (a record of truth is not read against another repo's index), and 207c4074b3d5's commit-in-the-same-act, which can't work under a hook until the commons is asked as itself.
answers.what: Every git the tester's red-ticket caster runs against the commons, and the outline check it fires, sees the commons as itself and never the index or git dir of the hook that called the reseal.

bullets.text: red_tickets ran the commons' git against cairn's hook index: 'unable to read 94b599b2c33f', and every held land_ours reseal COULD NOT RUN.
